module.purpose: Defines the intermediate representation (IR) types and classes for building database queries. Provides type-safe structures for query composition including collections, joins, where clauses, aggregates, subqueries, and conditional selects.
module.summary: This file defines the intermediate representation (IR) for database queries, providing a type-safe foundation for query building. It exports interfaces and types for query components (QueryIR, Select, Join, Where, etc.) and concrete classes for expression types (CollectionRef, QueryRef, UnionFrom, PropRef, Value, Func, Aggregate, IncludesSubquery, ConditionalSelect). Helper functions validate and manipulate IR structures, enabling runtime type checking and query analysis.
module.businessContext: Critical for the database query building system. Provides the type-safe IR foundation for constructing and validating queries. Failure breaks type safety and query construction across the entire data access layer.

IncludesSubquery (~L229-252): Represents a subquery with correlation fields

units.name: BaseExpression

detail.name: BaseExpression
detail.summary: Base class for the query intermediate-representation expression tree; provides the shared shape (sources array) that all concrete expression nodes (CollectionRef, QueryRef, UnionAll, PropRef, Value, Func, Aggregate, etc.) inherit from.

units.name: CollectionRef

detail.name: CollectionRef
detail.signature: class CollectionRef extends BaseExpression { constructor(public queries: Array<QueryIR>) }
detail.summary: CollectionRef is a query IR node representing a result-level UNION ALL reference. It accepts an array of QueryIR branches, extends BaseExpression, and is treated as a derived relation by compiler phases unless explicitly handling branch lowering.

units.name: QueryRef

detail.name: QueryRef
detail.summary: QueryRef is a class that defines an alias getter returning an empty string string.

specLiterals.role: empty string returned by alias getter

units.name: UnionFrom

detail.name: UnionFrom
detail.summary: A container representing a UNION of multiple source expressions in the intermediate representation (IR) for query building, used to model UNION set operations.

units.name: UnionAll

detail.name: UnionAll
detail.summary: Represents a UNION ALL expression in the query intermediate representation, combining the results of two subqueries or expressions without deduplication.

units.name: PropRef

detail.name: PropRef
detail.summary: A query IR node representing a reference to a property (field/column) on an entity or collection, forming part of the intermediate representation for a query tree.

units.name: Value

detail.name: Value
detail.summary: A query IR expression node representing a value derived from a correlated child query. It binds a child-side correlation field to a parent, specifies the result field name, and optionally carries parent-level WHERE filters, parent projections, materialization strategy, and a scalar field name.

specLiterals.role: Default materialization strategy when constructing a Value node — controls how the correlated child query result is materialized

units.name: Func

detail.name: Func
detail.summary: Represents a database function call expression (e.g., UPPER, CONCAT, NOW) in the query intermediate representation, holding the function name and its argument expressions.

units.name: Aggregate

detail.name: Aggregate
detail.summary: The Aggregate class models an aggregate function expression in a query IR, used for operations like count, sum, etc.

units.name: IncludesSubquery

detail.name: IncludesSubquery
detail.summary: Represents a subquery inclusion node in the query intermediate representation (IR), binding a subquery to a field name for relational inclusion or filtering.

specLiterals.role: The discriminating type literal for the node kind.

units.name: ConditionalSelect

detail.name: ConditionalSelect
detail.summary: ConditionalSelect is an intermediate representation node that models a conditional selection query, representing a SQL CASE or IFNULL/COALESCE-style expression within a database query plan.

units.name: isExpressionLike

detail.name: isExpressionLike
detail.summary: A type guard that checks if a provided value has the shape of an expression-like object.

postconditions: returns the from expression if alias matches the query's from alias

alias not matching any from or join clause

units.name: getHavingExpression

units.name: isResidualWhere
